title: Zerstreutes Hinausschaun
identity: Ho-kwen Austin Yip, Zerstreutes Hinausschaun (Absent-minded Window-gazing), 2017, 7:30, for soprano and alto saxophones with orchestra or piano. The assignment snapshot’s Donemus number 16931 is a different work, Die Lian Hua for flute; Donemus number 18125 identifies the correct saxophone work and lists a purchasable piano reduction.

evidence.claim: Donemus item 18125 identifies the correct work, orchestral instrumentation, 7:30 duration, 2017 composition, MYO commission, and a separately purchasable piano reduction. The incorrect Donemus item 16931 is Die Lian Hua for flute.
The composer’s thesis explains that the piano reduction is used for the recording project and identifies the saxophone pair.
Composer post describes the Kafka story inspiration and January 2018 premiere by Timothy Sun, Hugo Loi, and Macau Youth Symphony Orchestra.

Donemus public score preview (edition 18125), full orchestral score pp. 1 and 8 inspected. At the opening the soprano line enters after an initial rest with a sustained note and short tied/ornamented motion; on printed p. 8 the soprano line continues through tied notes and short figures while the alto line has a descending rapid beamed passage near the end. Exact range not established.
evidence.page: PDF pp. 3 and 10; printed p. 8 for latter

score_observations.observation: The opening orchestral page gives a delayed soprano entrance with a sustained note followed by short tied figures, marked expressive and moving from p toward mf. On printed p. 8, the soprano continues in longer tied notes with shorter figures, while the alto saxophone has a rapid descending beamed line at the page end. No exact range is inferred.
score_observations.page: PDF pp. 3 and 10; latter is printed p. 8

review_focus: Inference: the two soloists have differentiated writing in the inspected opening and printed p. 8, with the soprano entering over a sustained line and the alto taking a quick descending figure. Check coordination and line balance between the two saxophone parts.
collection_flag: Commissioned for Macau Youth Symphony Orchestra; published in both orchestral and piano-reduction forms.

score_links.description: Donemus item 18125 public preview, orchestra score excerpt; piano reduction is separately purchasable.

gaps: Only a partial orchestral score preview was inspected; the piano reduction and remaining score are not available in this review. No direct recording page verified.
proposed_corrections: Replace the incorrect Donemus item 16931 reference with item 18125. Add piano to the edition/instrument notes if the catalog intends to represent the separately published reduction.
